verdict.rationale: Convex has no built-in natural-language console. It does ship its own agent-facing tooling: an official MCP server that lets AI agents interact with a deployment, plus a first-party agent setup prompt. Its docs also say starting a project is as easy as asking your coding agent. Natural-language operation therefore works, but only through an external agent client, and the MCP server's tool scope is not detailed. missing for 10: a native natural-language interface within the product, documentation of which deployment operations the MCP tools cover, independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation.
